thread:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: page fired for service=redwood-inference-inference-queue, severity=high, trigger=5xx-rate spike. PD incident: INC1715002468. Paging primary oncall: sara (oncall). Please ack and assess impact.

sara (oncall): Acked. I'm on it. Seeing surge of 5xx from infer-worker-pool in eu-west1.

miguel: oncall - do we have any recent deploys? I checked deployments list, nothing in the last 30m.

sara (oncall): no recent deploys. Looking at logs now. Opening flare window and creating bridge.

eli: joining — can you paste a sample 5xx?

sara (oncall): log snippet:

```
2026-03-15T14:07:21Z ERROR inference-req handler failed status=502 model=redwood-v1 seq=512 err="device OOM: failed allocate" request_id=abc123
2026-03-15T14:07:22Z ERROR inference-req handler failed status=503 model=redwood-v1 seq=1024 err="kv cache miss and conv fallback timed out" request_id=abc124
```

neha: Hmm looks like memory pressure + timeouts. Are autoscaler metrics showing anything?

sara (oncall): autoscaler shows immediate drop in available pods: desired=80 current=45 (scale events queued). Throttling on GPU provisioning.

devops-runbook-bot: Suggested runbook: `inference-queue-5xx-fanout` - steps: 1) Pin traffic to fallback region/model, 2) Increase pool size manually, 3) Enable best-effort reclaim.

miguel: can we route traffic to dedicated fallback model variant (redwood-v1-small) to reduce memory footprint? That buys time for scale-up.

sara (oncall): I'm going to enable routing fallback policy now: `/api/route-update service=inference-queue fallback_model=redwood-v1-small priority=1`

sara (oncall): command run, response: `200 OK - routing update queued`

eli: while that takes effect, I'll manually bump Dedicated pool from 4 -> 8 instances in eu-west1: `gcloud compute instances set-managed-size --size=8 redwood-dedicated-eu-west1`

neha: I see initial routing partial: ~35% traffic to fallback model, error rate drops from 18% -> 7% in last 60s. Good signal.

sara (oncall): scaling action started. Manual pool grow in progress. ETA ~2m for more nodes.

miguel: start a health check on the KV cache to ensure no stale locks: `curl -sS http://cache-proxy/eval/health | jq .`

eli: pool scaled to 8, nodes reporting ready. Backpressure easing. Metrics: 5xx rate trending down to 2%.

sara (oncall): Good. Customer impact: monitoring dashboards show 5% of requests in EU have transient failures; US unaffected. Notifying CS.

neha: Any signs of request storms from a single tenant? Request IDs show fanout from a short-lived job id=job-77ed. Could be a poorly batched client.

miguel: If it's a single customer causing seq length spikes, we should throttle them while we investigate. Can we apply per-tenant rate limit?

sara (oncall): Applying temporary token-level throttle: `redwoodctl quotas set tenant=acct-314 rate=10/s` -> applied.

devops-runbook-bot: Note: remember to document throttle duration and escalate to account team if customer is affected.

eli: Error bucket down to 0.8% after throttle+fallback+scale. Let's start closing loop.

sara (oncall): I'll stay on incident for a handoff in 20m. If anyone picks it up earlier, ping.

miguel: I'll follow up on root cause — look into request patterns and whether client misconfigured batching. I'll put findings in the incident ticket.

neha: I'll draft a short CS note: "We experienced an intermittent 5xx spike in eu-west1 that affected a subset of requests; mitigation included temporary routing fallback to a smaller model, scaling of dedicated pool, and tenant throttling. No data loss reported."

sara (oncall): thanks all. Quick checklist before I hand off: 
- verify error rate stable <1% (yes)
- remove emergency throttles? keep until RG approves (keep)
- record time series and attach logs to INC1715002468 (done)

miguel: putting follow-up tasks: `INC1715002468 -> postmortem (owner:miguel), mitigation cleanup (owner:sara), customer outreach (owner:neha)`

sara (oncall): handoff note: I'm swapping to passive monitoring at 14:40 UTC; @eli you'll own if it regresses.

eli: acknowledged. Oncall takeover accepted at 14:40 UTC.

pagerbot: :white_check_mark: INC1715002468 status -> mitigated. Primary cause: tenant-induced seq spikes + transient GPU provisioning lag. Followups assigned.

neha: leaving CS ping in #customer-comms: "We're mitigating and will follow up in the incident report." :thumbsup:

sara (oncall): closing channel for active mitigation, will reopen if error rate >2% for 5m. Thanks team. :heart:
